title: Concept: observability of a production system
desc: Like a car dashboard, a black box recorder and a mechanic's manual together.

items.label: Logs
items.detail: Structured events with context. Event, field, level

items.label: Metrics
items.detail: Numbers over time, cheap to keep. Counter, gauge, histogram

items.label: Traces
items.detail: One request across services. Span, context propagation, tail sampling

items.label: Profiles
items.detail: Where CPU and memory go. Flame graph, CPU, heap

items.label: Service level objectives
items.detail: The promise, in numbers. Indicator, error budget, burn rate

items.label: Alerting on symptoms
items.detail: Page on what users feel. Symptom, threshold, routing

items.label: Incident response and runbooks
items.detail: Roles, timeline, review; what to do at 3 a.m. Commander, postmortem, steps

items.label: Instrumentation
items.detail: OpenTelemetry SDKs and auto-instrumentation. SDK, auto-instrumentation, semantic conventions

items.label: Pipeline and storage
items.detail: Agents, sampling, routing; hot, warm, cold tiers. Agent, routing, retention

items.label: Ownership
items.detail: Every service has a team and a rota. Team, rota, escalation
